exercises.title: Enhancement 1 — enhancement or replacement project?
exercises.problemHtml:
An enhancement project adds capabilities to an existing system. A replacement (reengineering) project replaces an existing application with a new custom system, a COTS package, or a hybrid. Classify.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Dự án nâng cấp hay thay thế?

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Enhancement 2 — expected challenges
exercises.problemHtml:
Expected challenges: changes that degrade performance users are used to; little or no documentation of the existing system; users who dislike changes; unknowingly omitting functionality vital to some stakeholders; stakeholders using the opportunity to request many new features. Counter gold plating and scope creep by tracing requirements to business objectives and implementing the highest-impact features first.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

exercises.title: Enhancement 3 — a gap analysis
exercises.problemHtml:
Gap analysis compares the functionality of the existing system with the desired new one (Figure 21-1). Write function gap(existing, desired, retire) returning { keep, add, missing }: keep = in both; add = only in desired (new capabilities); missing = in existing, not in desired, and not listed in retire — functionality that may be lost by mistake and must be confirmed with stakeholders. Compare names case-insensitively, trimmed; keep the original spelling of the first list that contains the item; each list sorted alphabetically (case-insensitive).

Requirements

  • On the sample with retire = ["export to fax"], missing = ["Print controlled-drug label"].
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Viết gap(existing, desired, retire) trả keep / add / missing (chức năng cũ có thể mất mà chưa được quyết định bỏ).

Yêu cầu

  • Với retire = ["export to fax"], missing = ["Print controlled-drug label"].
hintsJson: So sánh sau khi trim + toLowerCase.
missing = cũ, không có trong mới, không nằm trong danh sách bỏ.

starterCodeJson.name: gap.js

solutionCodeJson.name: gap.js

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: The dangerous column is missing: functionality nobody decided to retire, which some stakeholder may depend on — like the controlled-drug label.

kiem.chuanBi: const __KQ = (function () { try { return (((function(){if(typeof gap!="function")return"gap is not a function";var n=gap(EXISTING,DESIRED,["export to fax"]);return JSON.stringify(n.keep)!=='["Book appointment","Monthly report","Search patient"]'?"keep: got "+JSON.stringify(n.keep):JSON.stringify(n.add)==='["Online payment","SMS reminder"]'?"OK":"add: got "+JSON.stringify(n.add)})))(); } catch (e) { return (e && e.name === 'ReferenceError' ? 'missing: ' : 'error: ') + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)); } })();

So sánh phân biệt hoa thường.

exercises.title: Enhancement 4 — keeping performance levels (KPIs)
exercises.problemHtml:
Existing systems set expectations for performance and throughput; stakeholders have KPIs for existing processes they want maintained. A key performance indicator model (KPIM) identifies these metrics so stakeholders see the new system will perform at least as well.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Giữ các chỉ số hiệu năng (KPI) của quy trình hiện tại.

Yêu cầu

  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.
